patthana20.9:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ
patthana20.9:2.1: na araṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi.
patthana20.9:3.1: na saraṇañca na araṇañca dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, ekaṃ.
patthana20.9:4.1: hetuyā pañca, ārammaṇe dve, avigate pañca.
patthana20.9:5.1: na saraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca araṇo dhammo uppajjati na hetupaccayā, na araṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saraṇo dhammo uppajjati na hetupaccayā, na araṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca saraṇo dhammo uppajjati na hetupaccayā,
patthana20.9:6.1: na hetuyā dve. na ārammaṇe tīṇi. no vigate tīṇi,
patthana20.9:8.1: na saraṇo dhammo araṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo.
patthana20.9:9.1: na araṇo dhammo araṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. na araṇo dhammo araṇassa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. na araṇo dhammo saraṇassa ca araṇassa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo.
patthana20.9:10.1: na saraṇo dhammo araṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. na
patthana20.9:11.1: saraṇo dhammo araṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. na araṇo dhammo araṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo. na araṇo dhammo saraṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo.
patthana20.9:12.1: hetuyā cattāri, ārammaṇe cattāri, avigate satta,
patthana20.9:13.1: na saraṇo dhammo saraṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇa paccayena paccayo, upanissaya paccayena paccayo. purejāta paccayena paccayo,
patthana20.9:14.1: na hetuyā satta, na ārammaṇe satta. no vigate cattāri,
patthana20.9:15.1: (yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomampi paccaniyampi anulomapaccanīyampi paccaniyānulomampi gaṇitaṃ evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ). paccanīyānuloma duka paṭṭhānaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
